title: hyder utha rahe hai janaza rasool ka
body:
hyder utha rahe hai janaza rasool ka
maatam sara bana hai madina rasool ka
behaal hai rasool ki duqtar hussainio
do fatima yateem ko pursa rasool ka
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate ho chord kar hame ae nanajaa'n kahan
kehta hai roke chota nawaasa rasool ka
sar ko jhukaae roti hai baba ki sogwaar
zahra ki mout ho gayi marna rasool ka
<<DIVIDER>>
rona wo syeda ka wo kehna hussain ka
amma pata bataaiye nana rasool ka
hai wa-mohammed ki sada har taraf buland
rota hai jo hai qalb se shaida rasool ka
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder lita rahe hai lahad me rasool ko
sar peet'ta hai qabr pe kunba rasool ka
